command:
set -euo pipefail
for f in "$HOME/.local/share/applications/free-frank.desktop" "$HOME/.local/share/applications/free-pool-harness.desktop" "$HOME/Desktop/free-frank.desktop" "$HOME/Desktop/free-pool-harness.desktop" "$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush_knopf.sh" "$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush_knopf.py" "$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush.py"; do echo '===== '

' ====='; if [ -f "$f" ]; then sed -n '1,420p' "$f"; else echo MISSING; fi; done
echo '===== CRUSH.JSON REDACTED ====='; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os
p=os.path.expanduser('~/.config/crush/crush.json')
try:
 d=json.load(open(p))
except Exception as e:
 print('ERR',repr(e)); raise SystemExit
def r(x):
 if isinstance(x,dict):
  return {k: ('<REDACTED>' if any(s in k.lower() for s in ('key','token','secret','password','credential')) else r(v)) for k,v in x.items()}
 if isinstance(x,list): return [r(v) for v in x]
 return x
print(json.dumps(r(d),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
PY
echo '===== WHICH ====='; for x in cool-retro-term ptyxis gnome-terminal xterm crush; do printf '%s=' "$x"; command -v "$x" || true; done
echo '===== CRT CONFIG ====='; find "$HOME/.config" "$HOME/.local/share" -maxdepth 4 -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '(cool.?retro|swordfish|free.?frank)' | sort | head -120 | while read -r f; do echo ---"$f"; case "$f" in *.png|*.jpg|*.jpeg|*.ico) echo BINARY;; *) sed -n '1,260p' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; done
echo '===== SUDO/PKG ====='; sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo SUDO_N=YES || echo SUDO_N=NO; dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'cool-retro-term|qml-module|fonts-hack|fonts-terminus' | head -80 || true
